Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence because the lagoon binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. Splitting into 8 separate vaults presupposes a separate funded summit account and a separate escrow deposit for each, thus the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. A 364 account operation therefore ties up 11 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
